stories.title: Brewers Win First World Series Title — 4-1 in Game 5

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Milwaukee Brewers are World Series champions.

57 years. Five games. One franchise forever changed.

Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4-1 in Game 5. Misiorowski. Pratt. Megill. Contreras.

The wait is over. #Brewers

x_posts.text:

This is their moment. #Brewers

stories.title: William Contreras Named World Series MVP

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
William Contreras: 2026 World Series MVP.

.381 batting average. 4 RBI. 4 caught stealing. 10-for-13 on ABS challenges.

The slow trots. The throws to third. The hits when it mattered.

Contreras was the best player in this series. #Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Pat Murphy knew it before the vote:

"If people aren't noticing Contreras — he was maybe the MVP of the Dodgers series."

He was the MVP of the World Series, too.

William Contreras. World Series champion. WS MVP. #Brewers

Randy Arozarena. Tarik Skubal. Two of the best players available.

The catch: the CBA expires December 1. A lockout is coming.

Teams have weeks — not months — to get deals done.

stories.title: Rays Fall One Win Short — From G4 Heroes to WS Runners-Up

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Tampa Bay won Game 4 in 12 innings to stay alive.

They became only the 5th team in WS history to win G4 while trailing 3-0.

They gave everything they had.

One win short. A remarkable 2026 run for the Rays. #RaysUp
